notes: «حدثنا أبي، ومحمد بن الحسن قالا» : two co-transmitters in one level; «أبي» is the compiler's father, named only as «أبي»
«بإسناده يرفعه إلى» is a gap marker (rule 8): one unnamed link in its place
the Imam is written after «إلى» in the chain and is read as a narrator; the blessing is not part of the surface
the number «4-102» and «رضي الله عنهما» are left out
